Use when: confirming manifest SHA-256 digest conformance and commitment binding pri

tools.name: generate_zk_provenance_proof
tools.description: Computes a 0x01-prefixed SHA-256 custodial Merkle root, optical microtopography score (7200-9985 bps), underwriting recommendation, and Ed25519-signed ZK_PROV_V1 zero-PII provenance certificate. Use when: generating a pre-bind title attestation for an asset_id and policy_ref from custodial SHA-256 d

tools.name: verify_zk_provenance_proof
tools.description: Verifies an ariadne-zk-ed25519-v1 (ZK_PROV_V1) provenance certificate across Ed25519 signature validity, zero-PII enforcement, signed claim parity, optional pinned oracle key, and optional 0x01 SHA-256 custodial Merkle recomputation. Use when: auditing a certificate from generate_zk_provenance_proof

tools.name: batch_underwrite_portfolio
tools.description: Computes per-asset optical scores (bps), Merton jump-diffusion 99% stressed values, approved advances in integer USD cents, and effective LTV (bps) across 1-100 collateral items. Use when: sizing a fine-art or RWA credit facility from appraised cent values, optical scan digests, custody depth, and h

tools.name: verify_underwriting_compliance
tools.description: Audits a portfolio underwriting summary against the ANX-RFC-001 55% (5500 bps) Merton stressed advance cap, classifies optical forensic score thresholds, and returns the active ZK_PROV_V1 Ed25519 oracle public key and SHA-256 fingerprint. Use when: validating credit-committee LTV compliance on a bat
